def stage(d, it, sids, slot, data, keep=False, who=''):
    """EA_SELLERIMG_V1: prepare one image and stage it for a slot, the same way the page upload does.
    Used by the seller AI link. keep=True = the seller's original, no trimming (only shrunk to 2000 px
    and saved as JPG). Raises ValueError with a plain reason."""
    if slot not in KEYS:
        raise ValueError('unknown position - use main, 2 to 8 or swatch')
    if len(data) > MAX_UPLOAD:
        raise ValueError('the file is over 30 MB')
    out, wh, src, notes, prob = process(data, slot, keep)
    if prob:
        raise ValueError(prob)
    name = make_name(_brand(d, sids, it['asin']), it['title'], _terms(d, sids, it['asin']), slot)
    clash = d.execute("SELECT 1 FROM img_intel WHERE file=? AND NOT (seller_id=? AND sku=?) AND expired IS NULL "
                      "LIMIT 1", (name + '.jpg', it['seller_id'], it['sku'])).fetchone()
    if clash:
        name = (name[:-len(LABEL[slot])].strip() + ' ' + re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9 ]+', ' ', it['sku']).strip()
                + ' ' + LABEL[slot])
        name = re.sub(r' +', ' ', name)
    fn = name + '.jpg'
    _used = set(str(x[0]) for x in d.execute(
        "SELECT file FROM img_intel WHERE seller_id=? AND sku=? AND status IN ('sent','on listing','failed')",
        (it['seller_id'], it['sku'])).fetchall())
    k = 2
    while fn in _used and k < 50:
        fn = '%s V%d.jpg' % (name, k)
        k += 1
    name = fn[:-4]
    os.makedirs(DIR, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(DIR, fn), 'wb') as fh:
        fh.write(out)
    from urllib.parse import quote
    url = PUB + quote(fn)
    note = '; '.join(notes)
    vals = (it['asin'], fn, url, wh[0], wh[1], src[0], src[1], note, 'ready', _now(), who)
    if d.execute("SELECT 1 FROM img_intel WHERE seller_id=? AND sku=? AND slot=?",
                 (it['seller_id'], it['sku'], slot)).fetchone():
        d.execute("UPDATE img_intel SET asin=?, file=?, url=?, w=?, h=?, src_w=?, src_h=?, note=?, status=?,"
                  " uploaded_at=?, uploaded_by=?, sent_at=NULL, result=NULL, expired=NULL"
                  " WHERE seller_id=? AND sku=? AND slot=?", vals + (it['seller_id'], it['sku'], slot))
    else:
        d.execute("INSERT INTO img_intel(asin, file, url, w, h, src_w, src_h, note, status, uploaded_at,"
                  " uploaded_by, seller_id, sku, slot) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                  vals + (it['seller_id'], it['sku'], slot))
    d.commit()
    print('[IMGINTEL] stage seller %s sku %s slot %s %dx%d (was %dx%d) keep=%s by %s: %s'
          % (it['seller_id'], it['sku'], slot, wh[0], wh[1], src[0], src[1], keep, who, fn))
    return {'url': url, 'name': name, 'w': wh[0], 'h': wh[1], 'notes': notes}
